title: Towards Understanding Valuable Preference Data for Large Language Model Alignment
authors_zh: Zizhuo Zhang、Qizhou Wang、Shanshan Ye、Jianing Zhu、Jiangchao Yao、Bo Han、Masashi Sugiyama（香港浸会大学、悉尼科技大学、上海交通大学、东京大学、RIKEN AIP）
paper_type_zh: 模型相对的偏好数据选择与对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合需要用较少偏好对完成 DPO 或 SLiC 对齐的读者。
one_line: LossDiff-IRM selects preference pairs by approximating their model-specific validation influence.
该方法用近似验证集影响的 LossDiff-IRM 选择对当前模型真正有益的偏好对。
why: It shows that a preference pair's value is a model-relative training property, not an intrinsic label.
inclusion_reason: Directly selects pairwise preference records using a model-relative estimate of their alignment benefit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Preference cleaning often assumes a pair is universally good or bad. The paper argues that its value depends on the current model: the same chosen/rejected pair can improve one policy and harm another, while external rewards and generic judges miss that dependence.

It asks how to identify pairs that actually improve validation behavior for a particular alignment run. The authors use a truncated influence function as the reference notion of value, then seek a tractable score that can select records before DPO or SLiC training.

偏好数据清洗常假定一条偏好对天然地好或坏。论文认为其价值取决于当前模型：同一条选择/拒绝对可以改善一个策略，也可能损害另一个策略，而外部奖励与通用评判器无法捕捉这种依赖性。

它追问如何识别真正改善某次对齐运行验证表现的偏好对。作者将截断影响函数作为价值的参照定义，再寻找一种可处理的分数，使训练前能够选择 DPO 或 SLiC 所消费的记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core claim is that preference quality is model-relative influence, not a static annotation property. Exact truncated influence functions estimate a pair's effect on validation performance, but are too costly at scale.

LossDiff and IRM are two cheaper, imperfect scoring functions with different errors. Their combination, LossDiff-IRM, more closely tracks the influence reference and ranks pairs to train on; the feedback contract is validation improvement under the chosen alignment objective.

核心主张是：偏好质量是相对于模型的影响，而不是静态标注属性。精确的截断影响函数估计一条偏好对对验证表现的作用，但在大规模下成本过高。

LossDiff 与 IRM 是两个更便宜但各有误差的评分函数。它们的组合 LossDiff-IRM 更接近影响函数参照，并据此给偏好对排序；其反馈契约是所选对齐目标下的验证改进。

title: Method
方法
html:
The model first warms up on the preference-training set and then for a short stage on a validation set. It computes LossDiff from the two model states and IRM from the warmed-up policy, combines them, selects pairs, and retrains for a longer alignment stage.

The paper uses UltraFeedback-Binarized, holding out a GPT-4-margin-stratified 20% validation split and retaining 80% for training. It initializes models with one UltraChat-200k SFT epoch, then applies DPO or SLiC for two epochs. Exact influence, split construction, and the selected ratio must be logged for reproducibility.

模型先在偏好训练集上预热，再在验证集上进行短阶段训练。它从两个模型状态计算 LossDiff，从预热策略计算 IRM，将两者结合后选择偏好对，并在较长的对齐阶段重新训练。

论文使用 UltraFeedback-Binarized，将按 GPT-4 分数间隔分层的 20% 留作验证集，80% 用于训练。模型先在 UltraChat-200k 上进行一个 SFT epoch 初始化，再以 DPO 或 SLiC 训练两个 epoch。精确影响计算、划分构造和选择比例都必须记录，才能复现。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B-Base, and Pythia models, the paper reports up to 13.58% improvement over full-data training while using 50–64% of pairs. On Llama-3.1-8B DPO, LossDiff-IRM reports 83.97 single score and 87.08 win rate on AlpacaEval, above the listed MAP baseline's 79.99 and 80.88.

The scalable proxy also takes about five minutes on Llama-3.2-1B versus roughly ten hours for exact influence in the stated comparison. These results support selection efficiency, but the validation set is itself a critical signal: the paper's noise analysis shows that corrupted validation preferences change the selection outcome.

在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B-Base 和 Pythia 模型上，论文报告使用 50–64% 偏好对即可比全量训练最高提升 13.58%。对于 Llama-3.1-8B 的 DPO，LossDiff-IRM 在 AlpacaEval 上报告 83.97 的单项分数和 87.08 的胜率，高于所列 MAP 基线的 79.99 和 80.88。

在给出的比较中，可扩展近似在 Llama-3.2-1B 上约需五分钟，而精确影响约需十小时。这些结果支持选择效率，但验证集本身是关键训练信号：论文的噪声分析显示，受污染的验证偏好会改变选择结果。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier selectors use reward margins, curriculum heuristics, or a single model score. This work makes individual validation influence the reference definition of a valuable pair and then approximates that decision with two complementary signals.

Influence functions and preference optimization are not new. The changed decision is to combine LossDiff and IRM because their errors offset, making model-relative pair selection practical. Reuse should test the same pair under different policies and validation splits rather than treating its score as portable metadata.

已有选择器使用奖励间隔、课程启发式或单一模型分数。本工作将单条偏好对对验证集的影响作为价值的参照定义，再以两个互补信号近似这一决策。

影响函数和偏好优化并不新。改变的决策是组合 LossDiff 和 IRM，因为它们的误差可以互相抵消，使模型相对的偏好对选择变得可行。复用时应在不同策略和验证划分下测试同一偏好对，而不要把其分数视为可迁移的静态元数据。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The score is explicitly model- and validation-set-dependent, so it must be recomputed after a base-model, objective, or target-distribution change. It requires two warm-up stages and a trustworthy validation split; noisy or leaked validation preferences can make the selector optimize the wrong behavior. Although the code and datasets are public, exact influence remains expensive and the approximation's validity should be checked against a small exact-influence sample.
该分数明确依赖模型与验证集，因此更换基座模型、目标函数或目标分布后必须重新计算。它需要两个预热阶段和可信验证划分；带噪或泄漏的验证偏好会让选择器优化错误行为。虽然代码和数据集公开，但精确影响仍然昂贵，应以小规模精确影响样本检查近似是否有效。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this method when a team has a fixed preference pool, a clean validation signal, and needs to reduce DPO or SLiC cost without assuming external rewards define universal quality. Recreate the stratified validation split, score pairs, train selected and full-data controls with the same objective, and report ID/OOD results. Do not use it when validation data overlaps final evaluation or cannot represent the behavior being aligned.
当团队拥有固定偏好池、干净验证信号，并希望在不假定外部奖励定义普遍质量的前提下减少 DPO 或 SLiC 成本时，可以使用该方法。应重建分层验证划分，对偏好对评分，并以相同目标函数训练所选与全量对照组，报告 ID/OOD 结果。当验证数据与最终评测重叠，或无法代表待对齐行为时，不应使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Preference value is a property of a pair, a current model, and a validation objective together. Exact TIF is the diagnostic reference; LossDiff-IRM is the scalable training tool. The reported 20% validation split is not auxiliary bookkeeping but part of the selection algorithm. The five-minute versus ten-hour comparison explains why approximation matters. Audit validation noise before trusting the selected subset.
偏好价值是偏好对、当前模型和验证目标共同决定的属性。精确 TIF 是诊断参照；LossDiff-IRM 是可扩展训练工具。所报告的 20% 验证划分不是辅助记录，而是选择算法的一部分。五分钟与十小时的比较说明近似为何重要。信任所选子集之前，应先审计验证噪声。
